same_book_open_close.note: The Primeira/Eredivisie external Bet365 early-to-CLOSE diagnostic is fully rebuilt from clean source for 1X2 and O/U. It remains separate from GoldBet, whose 642 certified TRUE OPEN events still require exact same-book close/outcome joins.

market_close_benchmark.rule: Benchmark market closing prices may support CLV/context only under their true bookmaker/source labels; they never substitute GoldBet TRUE OPEN.

intermediate_t30.rule: Never derive T-30 from CLOSE or interpolate absent timestamps.

pre_match_structural.anti_leakage: Features use strictly prior source dates; updates occur only after the complete date batch.
pre_match_structural.result: Elo beats the development prior in Sweden, Norway and Netherlands, but not robustly in Denmark. Form/full bundles remain unpromoted in every league; external close remains non-GoldBet.
pre_match_structural.identity_gate: League-format integrity required before metrics: 16 teams/240 matches for Sweden-Norway; 12 teams/32 matches per club for Denmark; 18 teams/34 matches per club for Netherlands.

quarantine_rules: prospective 2026 snapshots are not multi-season historical evidence
FIRST_SEEN cannot substitute TRUE OPEN in primary MMS tests
non-GoldBet bookmaker odds cannot be relabelled GoldBet
single-fixture proofs cannot support threshold promotion
sources without unambiguous fixture identity or timestamps are excluded
post-kickoff facts are outcome/evaluation data only

acceptance_gate.structural_rule: Only prior source dates may enter rolling features because source timezone is not documented.
acceptance_gate.market_rule: AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA are closing odds under the provider's documented C-column semantics; retain external benchmark class.
acceptance_gate.primary_mms_reason: Certified GoldBet TRUE OPEN exists and may generate MMS signals. Historical ROI/CLV promotion still requires observed close and outcome joins.

next_source_block.goal: Join certified GoldBet TRUE OPEN to exact last-pre-kickoff same-book closes and outcomes; do not reuse external closing benchmarks as GoldBet evidence.
next_source_block.prior_claim_status: Primeira/Eredivisie 1X2 and O/U fully recovered; Eredivisie four-season structural OOS also complete under a separate frozen split.
next_source_block.structural_next: Keep all four completed league holdouts frozen; expand only with the unchanged specification and a new independent league.
